tracts.description: Owner marks two proposed 200 × 150 ft factories: inverter manufacturing and battery assembly. Positions are conceptual.
Owner marks data-center structures 1 (east), 2 (middle), 3 (west), plus a proposed 2,000 sq ft BESS area. A/B/C correspondence is unconfirmed.
Proposed solar development area. Former greenhouse/pad omitted from the proposed overlay as requested; historical source documents remain unchanged.

easements: Proposed 50-foot ingress/egress and utility easements appear on the plat. Obtain recorded documents and current title review.
limitations: This is the supplied survey copy, not a new survey, title opinion, engineering design or construction plan.
The survey notes no benefit of abstract/title opinion and no easement documents provided to the surveyor.
Surveyed structures do not establish present condition, data-center commissioning, exact A/B/C identity or permitted use.
